description: The run decision record. Every seat is a backend+model pair passed explicitly on every call (claude --model, codex -m, or the named openai_compat endpoint) — account and CLI defaults are never reachable. Change a decision here, in the studio's settings panel (which writes this file), per run from the launch form, or per-session via env (CLAUDE_MODEL / CODEX_MODEL / CODEX_EFFORT / ROUND_CAP, honored only when the seat runs the matching CLI backend). Opt-in open-weight backends are declared under `backends` (docs/MULTI-MODEL-SEATS.md has the shape); none exist until someone writes one down.
